usage.account: DevinProvider.getAccountUsage(): billing strategy, daily/weekly remaining percent and reset times from the last GetUserStatus seen at login validation or Pi's OAuth refresh check; cleared on logout, invalidation, re-login and shutdown
usage.session: sum of usage on devin assistant messages in the current branch (requests, input, output, cache read/write); sidekick child sessions excluded
usage.budget: DevinLifecycle.budget(): used/limit of the active or last execution
usage.statusLine: key devin-usage, TUI only, e.g. 'devin 100%/100% · ↑15 ↓10'; tokens only when the account is not quota-billed; cleared when the toggle is off
